compatibility.overlay: Independent environment effects. No water, foam or bubbles painted into the character.

production.method: Image generation from existing character identity and native-size extraction
production.prompt: Isolated 2.5D painted game sprite for exactly the existing character in the source. Direction throughout is lower right; clearly see face and torso from front right in all frames. Eight consecutive poses of full-body near-horizontal swimming under water with alternating leg flutter and arm recovery. Every pose is a small complete silhouette surrounded by genuine transparent alpha everywhere outside. A deliberately wide invisible 4 columns x 2 rows grid in chronological order. Important: keep figures within the central 60% of their cell. The entire outside of the silhouettes is TRANSPARENT, no color, shadow, lighting, checker pattern, outline, water, bubbles, foam, letters or copied tiles. Match exact hero's hair, face, proportions and clothing.
production.encoding: WebP lossless, verified RGBA including fully transparent pixels

review.technical: Native detail, cell clearance and distinct WEBP phases verified
